title: Kept alive
sub: AI and continuous architecture: a year on, the utility's map has drifted though every check passed, because the work, the words and the people moved without a change; keeping it becomes a capability with an owner, a budget and a rhythm, its agents read the map itself, never a copy, and the topic closes on what its five series said about maturing.
howto: Clay and dusk are Babylon in 331 BCE and after: Etemenanki falling into ruin, its bricks carried off to houses nearby, and today the hole in the ground its keepers look after. In the present, a teal orb is the map agent; the field app's assistant answers on a crew's tablet. The map is glass in its layers' colours, each element with its owner's gold tag. What has drifted is drawn in amber; a copy is a grey sheet, the map itself is glass. Blue is the network and rose is retail; gold marks owners and the business side, cyan the technical side.
